empty.text: Tapomo measures in the background. Bursts shorter than 15 characters don't count.

settings.title: Settings
settings.pause.hint: If you stop typing for longer than this, the burst ends and the pause isn't counted.
settings.fullscreen.hint: Games and presentations are not measured.
settings.exclusions.hint: Nothing is ever measured while one of these is in the foreground.
about.title: About
about.privacy: Tapomo never stores what you type: it only counts keystrokes and timings.
about.privacy_passwords: Password fields are ignored entirely: not counted, not timed.
live.title: Right now
live.idle: Type and watch your pace live
live.calibrating: Calibrating… Keep typing so Tapomo learns your normal pace ({have}/{need} long bursts)
settings.show_pet.hint: A small floating Tapomo that reacts as you type. It never takes focus, clicks go through it except over Tapomo itself, and it hides during fullscreen apps. Drag it to move it.
settings.logs.hint: Log files with Tapomo's warnings and errors. They never contain what you type or which keys you press.
tip.avg: Words per minute (1 word = 5 characters), only while you type continuously: pauses longer than {pause} s don't count. "Net" also subtracts what you delete.
tip.peak: Your highest speed held for 10 seconds in a row.
tip.best: Characters in a row without pressing delete (your best no-backspace streak). It is kept even if you pause.
tip.current: Characters you have typed in a row right now without pressing delete. Back to zero when you delete.
tip.time: Real time spent typing: the sum of your bursts, without the pauses.
tip.chars: Number of characters typed in this period. They are only counted: which characters they are is never stored.
tip.heatmap: Each square is one hour of a weekday. The stronger the colour, the higher your average speed in that hour and day.
tip.apps: Average speed and characters per program. You can give each one an alias by typing in its name.
tip.live: Compares your speed over the last 10 s with your usual good pace: 100% is the 90th percentile of your 10 s peaks over the last 30 days. You can go past it.
tip.burst: A burst is continuous typing. It ends when you stop for more than {pause} s, and bursts under 15 characters are discarded.
tip.longburst: Long burst: 10 seconds or more of typing without stopping. With {need} of them Tapomo knows your normal pace.
tip.pause: If you stop typing for longer than this, the burst ends and the pause is not counted in your speed.
tip.streak_today: Today your best streak is {n} characters without deleting!
tip.faster_than_usual: You're typing {p}% faster than usual today 🚀
tip.low_corrections: You only correct {p}% of what you type. Nicely done!
tip.near_record: Today's peak ({w} {u}) is just {d} {u} from your record
tip.record_today: You beat your speed record today: {w} {u}!
tip.best_hour: Your best hour is usually {h}:00. Make the most of it!
tip.volume_today: {n} characters so far today: about {pages} pages!
tip.calibrating: Keep typing: I'm learning your pace ({have}/{need})
tip.hello_empty: Hi! We haven't typed anything together yet today
tip.generic_1: Thinking pauses don't count: type at your own pace
tip.generic_2: If I get in the way, you can hide me from the tray
tip.generic_3: I never save what you type, I only count keys
gloss.title: Glossary
gloss.wpm.d: A "word" is 5 characters (spaces included), the international standard, so text with long words doesn't penalise you. Not the same as the keystrokes per minute used by typing schools: 1 WPM ≈ 5 keystrokes/min (60 WPM ≈ 300 keystrokes/min).
gloss.burst.d: Continuous typing without pauses longer than {pause} s. Bursts under 15 characters don't count.
gloss.peak.d: Your highest speed held for 10 seconds in a row.
gloss.streak.d: Characters in a row without pressing delete.
gloss.pace.d: Your usual good pace: the 90th percentile of your peaks over the last 30 days. You can beat it.
gloss.calibration.d: Tapomo needs {need} bursts of 10 s or more to learn your pace.
pet.hint: Click: say something · Double-click: open · Right-click: more
gloss.pet.d: Drag it to move it. Click: it tells you something. Double-click: opens this window. Right-click: menu (open, hide for an hour, hide, pause measuring).
pet.hide.fullscreen: I'm hiding while you watch something fullscreen
